question: Should OpenClaw expose outbound delivery failures to agents as a shared system event, structured message-tool/agent delivery status, or both?
rationale: The choice changes model-visible context, plugin SDK expectations, channel ownership, and recovery semantics, so source inspection cannot safely choose the permanent contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Shared typed delivery contract
options.body: Define a single delivery-failure/status contract over existing durable outbound outcomes and decide exactly where agents may observe it.

options.title: Tool/status only
options.body: Limit the change to structured agent/tool result status and avoid injecting new system events into session context.

options.title: Keep narrower status paths
options.body: Leave current CLI, cron, restart-recovery, and channel-specific handling as supported behavior and close this request as not planned.

recommendation.title: Shared typed delivery contract
recommendation.body: Define a single delivery-failure/status contract over existing durable outbound outcomes and decide exactly where agents may observe it.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history trail for the central outbound, channel delivery, and source-delivery contract surfaces points to this owner.
